title: Creamy Rice Pudding with Red Berry Compote
summary: A creamy stovetop rice pudding with vanilla, topped with a quick red berry compote.

ingredients.item: pudding rice or short-grain white rice
fine sea salt or table salt
mixed red berries (cherries, raspberries), fresh or frozen

steps.title: Par-cook
steps.text: bring the water and salt to the boil, stir in the rice, cover and simmer on low 15 min until most of the water is absorbed. Starting in water softens the rice so it cooks faster in the milk.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: add the milk, cream and sugar, bring back to a simmer and cook uncovered, stirring often, 30-35 min. Turn the heat to low and keep stirring every couple of minutes 10-15 min more, until thick and creamy and the rice is very soft. Stirring stops the milk catching and releases starch for creaminess.

steps.title: Flavour
steps.text: take off the heat and stir in the vanilla; the pudding thickens as it stands.

steps.title: Compote
steps.text: simmer the berries, sugar and lemon juice 8-10 min until jammy, then cool slightly. A short simmer keeps the fruit bright.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: spoon the pudding into bowls warm or cold, loosening with a splash of milk if needed, and top with a spoonful of compote.

tips: A common mistake is cooking on high heat, which scorches the milk; keep it at a gentle bubble.
Take it off the heat while it is still a little loose, as it thickens as it cools.
Use frozen berries out of season.
storage: Cool quickly and keep covered in the fridge for up to 3 days. Reheat with a splash of milk until piping hot (74 °C). Keep the compote separately for up to 5 days.
